# Test corpus

Real open-access marketing papers used to exercise the PDF upload path.
Citation counts are Google Scholar "Cited by" figures, checked 2026-09-03.

Only the first file ships with the repository (its licence allows it). The
others are git-ignored; download them locally from the links below if you want
the full corpus test to run. Do not commit them.

| File | Ships? | Paper | Cited by | Source of PDF | Licence / version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| henseler-ringle-sarstedt-2015-discriminant-validity.pdf | yes | Henseler, Ringle & Sarstedt (2015), "A new criterion for assessing discriminant validity in variance-based structural equation modeling", *Journal of the Academy of Marketing Science* 43:115-135 | 54,458 | https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/s11747-014-0403-8.pdf | CC BY 4.0, publisher version |
| lemon-verhoef-2016-customer-journey.pdf | no | Lemon & Verhoef (2016), "Understanding Customer Experience Throughout the Customer Journey", *Journal of Marketing* 80(6):69-96 | 12,850 | University of Groningen repository, https://pure.rug.nl/ws/files/81733365/Understanding_Customer_Experience_Throughout_the_Customer_Journey.pdf | Repository copy of publisher PDF, no explicit licence |
| prahalad-ramaswamy-2004-co-creation.pdf | no | Prahalad & Ramaswamy (2004), "Co-creation experiences: The next practice in value creation", *Journal of Interactive Marketing* 18(3):5-14 | 11,871 | University of Michigan Deep Blue, https://deepblue.lib.umich.edu/bitstreams/e610c8fe-cfe0-4c62-ae21-29caeabd7b4b/download | Repository copy, no explicit licence |

## optional/ (git-ignored)

Local-only files kept for edge-case testing. Not redistributable.

| File | Note |
| --- | --- |
| optional/parasuraman-zeithaml-berry-1988-servqual.pdf | SERVQUAL (1988). Zenodo record 14579730. A ResearchGate scan: 30 pages, image-only except a cover sheet. Used as the "scanned PDF with a text cover page" case. Uploader is not the rights holder. |
| optional/vargo-lusch-2004-service-dominant-logic.pdf | Vargo & Lusch (2004), *Journal of Marketing*. Copy served from a UC Berkeley course page (dret.net), not a formal repository. Text-readable. Rights unclear. |
